verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Apify is a scraping platform that runs developer code built on Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy and Crawlee, and offers a generic web-scraper Actor. That implies developers can write selector-based field extraction inside their Actors, but no item explicitly documents CSS or XPath selector rules. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on CSS/XPath selector extraction, examples of field-level selector configuration (e.g. a web-scraper pageFunction), and hands-on corroboration of selector-based extraction quality.
